fields.Name: IT87 - Nested Transactions (ambient savepoints)
fields.Description: Live-DB proof of GenericDatabaseProvider nested savepoints. NT1 join via BeginEntityTransaction; NT2 inner commit is not physical; NT3 three-deep LIFO; NT4 savepoint counter restarts; NT5 torn-write invariant (doomed ambient TX cannot commit inner work without the outer row); NT6 public-API recovery after doom; NT7 order-confirm shape; NT8 serialized concurrent units; NT9 transactionState$ false at depth 0. Server transport, mutation-gated via runMutationTests so the bundle fires on PR CI. Self-cleaning prefixed MJ: Action Categories. Teardown uses ResetTransactionState plus pool-scoped reads so a poisoned handle cannot block sweep.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Savepoints join, inner commit is not physical, LIFO rollback is correct, a doomed ambient TX cannot tear a write, and the provider is usable afterwards via public API only.
